# algosec_device_zones (Data Source)

Topology zones from analyzed device data. Partial results reported by additionalInformation fail rather than silently returning an incomplete inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "algosec_device_zones" "example" {
  device_name = "ExampleDevice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_name` (String) Device name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Lookup identity.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Complete returned inventory, deterministically ordered. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `device_name` (String) Device name.
- `interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces.
- `ip_address` (String) Ip address.
- `name` (String) Name.
